identity.fantasy: A block-and-retaliation fire tank whose imps, Abyssal and attackers feed Rage into shields, rebukes and unusually strong self-healing.
identity.one_line: Pull with ranged fire and summons, let blocks and hits generate the engine, then spend Rage on mitigation or repeatable healing while commanding pets and keeping threat spread.

mechanics.core_loop: Establish imp and Abyssal pressure, use block-triggered retaliation for threat, and convert Rage into the heal, shield or mitigation needed for the next damage event.

mechanics.single_target: Single-target threat is reported strong; keep the no-cooldown heal and major cooldowns available rather than over-spending Rage.
mechanics.aoe: Many attackers generate abundant Rage, enabling repeated healing and easy fire threat once the pack is gathered.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Mounted Combat and ranged pet or fire actions give better pickup than a purely stationary block tank.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Players report a persistent HoT, a minute heal, a large shield, damage reduction and a nearby-enemy heal that can refill health on large pulls.
mechanics.group_utility: Imps, Abyssal, grips, rebukes and group mitigation make the tank more than a passive shield wall.

failure_modes.text: Dumping Rage into damage before a spike removes the resource needed for mitigation or healing.
Pet pathing or premature summons can complicate a pull.
Small-target encounters generate less attacker-fed Rage than mass pulls.
